{{Top}}
{{Quote|Activate the droids.''"<br />"''Yes, sir|[[Daultay Dofine/Legends|Daultay Dofine]] gives [[Tey How/Legends|Tey How]] the orders to activate [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9's]] droid army|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
The '''Central Control Computer''' controlled the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]].

As early as [[3951 BBY]], the droid control center on the ''[[Visionary]]'' controlled [[G0-T0's Droid Army|thousands of droids]], on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and elsewhere.

Before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] used [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] that were all subject to the Central Control Computer. This [[Computer/Legends|computer]], located on an orbiting [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] or station, allowed the [[droid control program]] to instantly relay information and orders from unit to unit no matter where they were on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

The weakness to this system was shown during the Battle of Naboo. Once the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] [[Vuutun Palaa/Legends|''Vuutun Palaa'']] was destroyed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], all the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] simply froze where they were. Also, if the channels were jammed, the once deadly army would be reduced to pieces of statuary.

This technique would lose favor with CIS battle droids during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], with the Separatists equipping at least some of their battle droids with separate [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brains]] so they could continue to provide resistance against GAR forces even after the destruction of the planet's central control computers.
